title: 情報デザイン学
subtitle: Information Design and Methodology
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn: (1) a variety of topics, such as visual and auditory information design. (2) the methodology of information design for accurate, immediate, and comfortable transmission. (3) how to transmit information about regional culture effectively.
advice: This is an information design course. We will cover the following topics: 1. Methodology of information design 2. Human sense perception and its relationship to information design 3. Logical structure and logical argument 4. Social media and information design 5. Information design in regional culture development
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to be aware of information design in daily life and think about ways to effectively transmit information.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand various forms of information.
Ability to understand the methodology of information design.
Ability to explain characteristics of sense perception.
Abiity to perform the appropriate logical development.
Ability to analyze the influence of social media.
Ability to choose suite information media in communications.
